messages:
tess: quick flag 00: p99 for /v1/respond (compact-route) shows a sharp tail only after yesterday's rollout. p50/p95 look normal. anyone else seeing a one-off tail?
omar: saw it on the timeline. interestingly the sample_count for that sub-slice dropped from ~140 -> 12 at the exact roll timestamp.
jin: pulled traces. a small fraction hit an extra proxy that adds ~220ms transport. service_time unchanged.
tess: sounds like mixed-origin rollup — our UI labels percentiles by endpoint only so it's easy to misread.
omar: agreed. two user-facing fixes: (1) show a "confidence" badge when sample_count < 50; (2) surface origin provenance next to each percentile (e.g., p99 (origin=proxy)).
jin: telemetry note: we should expose percentiles scoped by origin via API param origin=ingress|proxy|backend. that'll let infra tests assert backend-only p99.
ops-bot: Task created: MET-1102 - expose per-origin percentile filter in metrics API.
mira: small UX win: when a routing rollout changes weights by >2% for any cohort, display an inline note: "Routing change may affect tail latencies for small cohorts. View per-origin breakdown." link to per-origin view.
tess: also let's mute high-severity p99 paging when sample_count < 30. paging on noisy tails wastes ops cycles.
omar: i'll PR an alerting pre-check to downgrade severity to info for low-sample p99 and include sample_count in alert body.
jin: frontend hotfix: if the percentiles in the panel come from mixed provenance (e.g., p95 from 'rollup' and p99 from 'backend'), hide values and show: "Percentile sources differ for this slice; open provenance view." we can follow with provenance tags. i'll open PR.
mira: +1. add a hover that explains small-N variance and suggests running a backend-only check: `GET /metrics/percentiles?endpoint=/v1/respond&origin=backend`.
ops-bot: NOTE: logged INF-331 to audit why fallback weight changed after rollout.
tess: can someone add a simple repro command for the lab so we can create a synthetic fallback cohort?
omar: paste this in infra lab: ```bash
for i in {1..300}; do curl -s -w "%{time_total}\n" -o /dev/null "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/respond?prefix=compact-test"; done | sort -n | tail -n 20
```
jin: after tooltip + provenance API land, we should run the script and compare p99?origin=backend vs panel p99 to confirm transport is root cause.
mira: UX follow-up: add an amber "low-sample" pill showing N and a tooltip: "Low sample: percentiles may be unstable. Use per-origin filter to isolate transport vs service.".
tess: awesome. recap: jin frontend hotfix, omar alerting change, MET-1102 telemetry task, INF-331 infra audit, mira UX copy. i'll watch staging for 48h after deploy. will update thread with results. :thumbsup:
